messages:
maria_sales: Kicking off Newark POC — they want to test extraction + numeric reasoning on financial reports. Can we confirm which model variant to recommend for the evaluation window? They prefer hosted but will consider Dedicated for perf.
alex_ml_eng: TL;DR: for long docs (~8k tokens) + lots of tables, 7B will be fast but may miss cross-row numeric relations. 13B-quant (int8) is the sweet spot for recall vs latency.
maria_sales: Got it. Any config changes we should ask them to test during the POC? e.g., seq length, batching?
alex_ml_eng: Yes — ask for:
- seq_len: 8192 (or sliding window if >8k)
- kv_cache: enabled
- max_new_tokens: 256 (for extraction tasks)
- beam: disabled (use greedy)
Also add prompt templates for table normalization.
sam_se: One compatibility thing: their tokenizer is sentencepiece (custom vocab). If they upload a tokenizer file we can mount it, otherwise we should use tokenizer_override in the request.
alex_ml_eng: Example model config we recommend they try:
```
model: "rwd/llamax-13b"
weights: "int8"
seq_len: 8192
kv_cache: true
tokenizer_override: "/mnt/tokenizers/newark_sp.model"
```
maria_sales: They shared a link to model weights + tokenizer: s3://newark-poc/weights/v1/
ben_prod: Pricing note for Dedicated reserve (approx):
- 13B int8 reserved pool: $18k/month (baseline 16 concurrent tokens/sec)
- Hosted eval (pay-as-you-go): ~ $0.20 / 1k prompt tokens (estimate depends on batching)
We can give a tighter number after we profile with their sample workload.
lia_security: Security asks:
- Will any input data be logged or retained in hosted mode? We need to confirm retention policy and KMS usage.
- Can we support VPC endpoints for model pull if they want private deploy?
alex_ml_eng: For hosted eval we can disable logging/session retention per-customer. Private/VPC: yes, model pull via S3 over customer VPC is supported and we can integrate customer KMS for key wrapping.
maria_sales: Newark also has a security questionnaire — flagged "data residency" and "audit logs" as blockers.
lia_security: Action: I will add standard answers + indicate Private option for audited logs. For hosted eval, note that logs are ephemeral and opt-out available. Also: provide SOC2 doc link.
sam_se: Quick technical blocker: model sharding — their 13B uses 2-way tensor parallel. Our runtime supports it but requires the variant to be packaged with shard metadata. If they give a single-file fused weight we need to know format (hf safetensors / custom sharded tar).
alex_ml_eng: If they can export to safetensors single-file or HF sharded, we can onboard. If they only have a custom fused binary we may need an adapter — that's +2 days.
maria_sales: Okay. I'll ask them to confirm format and share a small sample bundle.
ben_prod: I've kicked off an internal profile job — deploy-bot should post results in ~30m.
deploy-bot: profiling job started for s3://newark-poc/weights/v1/ — estimated completion 28m.
maria_sales: Great. Final ask for the thread: can engineering confirm an end-to-end checklist we can share with Newark (model format, tokenizer, seq_len, retention opt-out, pricing ballpark)?
alex_ml_eng: I’ll assemble checklist and a minimal runbook: upload tokenizer, provide sample input files (5-10 docs), pick seq_len, choose quant (int8 recommended). I’ll attach sample inference call we use for profiling.
alex_ml_eng: Sample inference curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/llamax-13b","input":"<doc content>","max_new_tokens":256,"seq_len":8192}'
```
maria_sales: Perfect — I’ll collate and send to Newark + their security contact. Thanks all :pray:
lia_security: I’ll follow up with the SOC2 link and sample questionnaire answers by EOD.
ben_prod: Once profiling finishes I’ll update pricing estimate with measured throughput numbers.
maria_sales: Action items summarized:
- maria_sales: ask Newark for tokenizer format + sample docs + confirm model shard format
- alex_ml_eng: produce checklist + runbook (ETA today)
- lia_security: provide questionnaire answers + SOC2 link
- ben_prod: update pricing after profile
End.
